featured_reviews.review_text: Our Lady of Good Counsel Church(OLGC)  is one of the oldest churches in Sion, Mumbai built by the Portuguese. It was built at Sion and was initially affiliated to the St.Michael Church at Mahim in 1596. Our Lady of Good Counsel Convent High School was established in 1939 as primary School later in 1958 as High on the premises of the Church.Its a co-ed school.The school has excellent extra curricular all round activities especially sports,Girls basketball team is well known..The is affiliated to the Maharashtra State Board of Education.

featured_reviews.name: Lizann Lobo
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our Lady of Good Counsel Church in Sion is a beautiful and serene place of worship, offering a quiet space for reflection amidst the hustle and bustle of Mumbai. With its classic architecture, well-maintained interiors, and peaceful ambiance, the church holds a timeless charm that draws both the faithful and visitors alike.

The parish community is warm and welcoming, and the Mass services are reverent and meaningful, often accompanied by soulful choir singing. The church compound is also spacious and clean, providing a calm and spiritual environment.

Whether you're attending Mass, seeking a moment of peace, or simply admiring its heritage, this church is truly a spiritual landmark in the Sion area.

featured_reviews.name: Lavena Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: Prayers at St. Michael’s Church are especially known for the Wednesday Novena to Our Lady of Perpetual Succour. People from all walks of life come here with deep faith, seeking Mother Mary’s blessings for healing, financial support, employment, family peace, and strength to overcome personal struggles. Many also visit to offer thanksgiving for answered prayers. Devotees write their petitions and place them in the prayer box, while offering candles as a sign of faith and devotion. It is truly a peaceful and comforting place that brings inner peace to many. God bless.

featured_reviews.name: Sam Red (Rockred)
featured_reviews.review_text:
Review- I rather give a brief history of this Church.

Earlier in 1990’s There was no church all the way between Kalwa to Vashi. Though Airoli parishioners first went to attend mass in local catholics houses any big event like baptism, holy communion and confirmation had to be done in a church. At that time all major events like Easter mass, Christmas good Friday was celebrated in this church at Ghansoli as it is big and can accommodate many people. So people from all the way Digha, Airoli, Kopar khairane came to this church of Our Lady of the Forsaken by buses.

Now if you wonder if there were hardly any catholics how did this church exist in Ghansoli? Actually Ghansoli and Taloli was full of catholics who lived here from early 1970’s and even before that. Majority were angloindians, Goans they lived here as most of them worked in NOCIL petrochemical refinery which was just opposite the Thane belapur road. Most of them were fabricators, welders, fitters. As the refinery closed down many started to move out for better pastures. Some to Airoli and rest migrated abroad.

Now I’m not sure what the crowd is like there as I myself have not visited this church in decades. But this church is a miraculous place.

featured_reviews.name: Keerthi Cheeli
featured_reviews.review_text:
When I came to Mumbai for the first time, I didn’t know where to go for church. Later, I searched on Google Maps and found Good Shepherd Church. I immediately called the number, and Pastor Thavaneshan Garu answered. He informed me about the 9–11 AM English service, and we attended it.

I don’t know why, but Pastor called me forward and asked me to pray among everyone. I did, and that moment marked the beginning of my spiritual journey. From then on, I started attending church every week. Later, Pastor gave us an opportunity to sing songs in Telugu, which further strengthened my faith.

With God’s help and the guidance of Pastor Thavaneshan Garu, my spiritual journey began with greater power. Meera sister is also very sweet and welcoming in nature, which made us feel at home. Pastor continuously gave opportunities to grow spiritually and encouraged us to deepen our faith.

This is the only church I have seen that truly gives people chances to grow, gain knowledge, and share the Word of God with people. Whenever I go to this church, I am filled with the Holy Spirit. Pastor always speaks prophetic words and is very enthusiastic about doing God’s work. His energy, passion, and hard work inspire and push me to grow in Christ.

This church is the best church in Maharashtra. It is truly awesome. Must visit this place.
